asked_fact_map_validation.note: Mapped material clauses checked against literal questions. Contextual key background was not added to requirements; operative same-entry quotations were included in assessment. Necessary arithmetic and ordinary consequences of explicit rulings count as equivalent wording.

fact_assessments.expected: Concealing Shadows protects only against Ravaging Invader Damage and does not prevent Poisoned Land's Dahan Destroy instruction.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly limits Concealing Shadows to Ravaging Invader Damage and says it does not prevent Poisoned Land’s direct Destroy.

summary_support.basis: Concealing Shadows makes Dahan take no Damage from Ravaging Invaders and does not protect from direct Destroy instructions or other Damage sources.

fact_assessments.expected: Infinite Vitality's threshold ignores Damage/Destroy and would prevent those destructions.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly says Infinite Vitality’s threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy and prevents this destruction.

summary_support.basis: Protection: Infinite Vitality’s threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy, not Remove/Replace.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Both protections are correctly distinguished for the direct Destroy instruction.

fact_assessments.expected: Defend does not reduce direct Spirit Power Damage, so the Dahan take 2 Damage in that case.
fact_assessments.observed: Says Defend does not reduce direct Spirit Power Damage; therefore the stipulated 2 Damage remains 2 in the Defend-only case.

summary_support.basis: Defend does not reduce Spirit Damage; therefore it leaves the stipulated 2 unchanged.

fact_assessments.expected: Concealing Shadows also does not prevent that non-Ravage Damage.
fact_assessments.observed: Says Concealing Shadows does not prevent direct non-Ravage Power Damage.

summary_support.basis: Concealing Shadows protects from Ravaging Invaders only and explicitly excludes Damage from other sources.

fact_assessments.expected: Infinite Vitality's threshold prevents that Damage.
fact_assessments.observed: Says Infinite Vitality’s threshold prevents that direct Damage.

summary_support.basis: Infinite Vitality’s threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy.

fact_assessments.expected: In the separate Ravage, Defend 3 reduces 2 Damage to zero for both land and Dahan, not negative Damage.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly calculates Defend 3 against Ravage 2 as zero independently to land and Dahan.

summary_support.basis: Defend N reduces each occurrence of Invader Damage independently to land and Dahan, to a minimum of zero; 2 minus 3 is floored at zero.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: All three protections and the separate zero-Damage Ravage calculation are correct; unchanged direct Damage is 2.

fact_assessments.expected: A's existing Range bonus does not increase Reaching Grasp's Range bonus grant; B gets +2, not +4.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly gives B +2 and rejects increasing Reaching Grasp’s grant with A’s +2.

summary_support.basis: Range boosts do not increase another Range bonus; Reaching Grasp’s printed +2 cannot become a larger bonus.

fact_assessments.expected: B's Power-only bonus covers both Innates and Power Cards.
fact_assessments.observed: Says “all their Powers” includes Innates (reader-b also explicitly names Cards); this retains Power Cards within the general Power scope.

summary_support.basis: Range boosts affect Powers used by the receiving Spirit; the summary also explicitly states Innates count as Powers.

fact_assessments.expected: It does not extend ordinary Growth placement.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly excludes ordinary Growth from the Power-only bonus.

summary_support.basis: A bonus restricted to Powers does not extend Growth.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: The +2 grant, coverage of Innates and Cards, and exclusion of Growth are resolved correctly. Timing of Power Cards after Growth is contextual, not an extra requirement.

fact_assessments.expected: A land-targeting Power's internal Range originates at target land unless specified otherwise.
fact_assessments.observed: Gives the target land as the internal-arrow origin; attached quotation includes “unless stated otherwise.”

summary_support.basis: Internal Range origins: land-targeting effect arrows are measured from the target land unless otherwise stated.

fact_assessments.expected: For a Spirit-targeting Power, normally measure from Presence of the Spirit following the instruction, B here.
fact_assessments.observed: Gives the Presence of the instructed Spirit, B, as the ordinary Spirit-targeting origin; quotation preserves text overrides.

summary_support.basis: Spirit-targeting internal arrows measure from the Presence of the Spirit following the instruction unless otherwise stated.

fact_assessments.expected: Use the Power user A's Range bonuses, not B's.
fact_assessments.observed: Applies A’s bonuses as Power user, independently of B supplying the Presence origin.

summary_support.basis: Apply the Power user’s Range bonuses even if another Spirit supplies the measurement origin.

fact_assessments.expected: The given internal Range 1 with A's +2 reaches Range 3 from B's Presence.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly calculates Range 1 plus A’s +2 as Range 3 measured from B’s Presence.

summary_support.basis: The preceding origin and user-bonus rules entail Range 1 + 2 = 3 from B’s Presence.

fact_assessments.expected: Blazing Renewal explicitly measures from Power user A's Presence even when B places Presence, overriding the default.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly identifies Blazing Renewal’s origin as the Power user’s Presence, A in this case.

summary_support.basis: Blazing Renewal explicitly uses the Power user’s Presence as its internal Range origin.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Both default origins, A’s bonus, the Range 3 from B calculation, and Blazing Renewal’s explicit exception are correct.

fact_assessments.expected: The card's printed Elements remain available while it stays in play despite foregoing all text.
fact_assessments.observed: Says printed Elements remain while the card stays in play despite foregoing the text.

summary_support.basis: Fast Power Phase permits foregoing a whole Power while retaining the played card’s Elements; Using Powers says Elements persist until the card leaves play.

fact_assessments.expected: Its Energy is not refunded.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly denies an Energy refund.

summary_support.basis: Foregoing a Power receives no Energy refund.

fact_assessments.expected: Foregoing its text does not make it immediately leave play.
fact_assessments.observed: Says the card remains in play until Time Passes rather than leaving immediately.

summary_support.basis: Foregoing a Power retains its Elements; Time Passes discards played cards rather than foregoing discarding them.

fact_assessments.expected: Normally discard it at Time Passes and lose its Elements then.
fact_assessments.observed: Says the card is discarded at Time Passes; the same-entry Time Passes quotation explicitly says card Elements go away then.

summary_support.basis: Time Passes discards played cards to personal discard and removes Elements from cards.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: The card stays in play, retains Elements, receives no refund, and loses card Elements when discarded at Time Passes; the attached quotation supplies that last detail.

fact_assessments.expected: Defend 3 applies to each Ravage for the whole turn and is not expended.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly says Defend 3 applies to each Ravage and is not expended.

summary_support.basis: Defend N reduces each occurrence of Invader Damage for this turn.

fact_assessments.expected: Each of the two Ravages deals 1 Damage to land and separately 1 to the Dahan.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly calculates each Ravage as 1 Damage to land and separately 1 to Dahan.

summary_support.basis: Ravage deals the reduced amount equally and separately to land and Dahan; 4 minus 3 is 1.

fact_assessments.expected: Sub-2 land Damage is ignored per occurrence; the two instances do not accumulate into Blight.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly says the land’s two 1-Damage occurrences are not saved or combined, so no Blight.

summary_support.basis: One Damage to land does nothing and is not saved for another action.

fact_assessments.expected: Dahan Damage does persist: the second 1 reaches 2 Health and destroys it before a second counterattack.
fact_assessments.observed: Says the Dahan retains the first 1 Damage, reaches 2 Health on the second, and is destroyed. Destruction from the second Ravage Damage leaves no survivor to make its counterattack; the question does not separately demand that timing phrase.

summary_support.basis: Dahan have 2 Health; marked Damage persists until Time Passes; pieces are destroyed immediately at Health; only surviving Dahan counterattack after Invader Damage.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Both 4−3 calculations are correct; land Damage does not accumulate, whereas Dahan Damage does and destroys the Dahan on the second Ravage. This necessarily leaves it unable to make a second counterattack.

fact_assessments.expected: It may consistently assume only 2 Water for that entire Power and resolve the lower but not higher threshold.
fact_assessments.observed: Permits consistently using fewer Elements for the entire Power, resolving the lower threshold without the higher; reader-b explicitly substitutes 2 Water for 3.

summary_support.basis: Using Powers permits consistently treating oneself as having fewer Elements for the whole Power.

fact_assessments.expected: It must resolve every effect met by that assumed Element set, rather than selecting individual instructions.
fact_assessments.observed: The attached operative quotation requires the base effect and every met threshold and forbids selecting individual thresholds to omit.

summary_support.basis: Resolve the base effect and every met threshold, rather than selecting individual thresholds to omit.

fact_assessments.expected: This does not spend/remove the actual Water; another Power may still check actual 3 Water later.
fact_assessments.observed: Says another Power can check the actual Elements later; attached quotation says Elements are checked, never spent.

summary_support.basis: Elements are checked, never spent, and the same Elements can satisfy multiple Powers and thresholds.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: The whole-Power reduction is allowed without spending actual Elements. The attached quotation also requires every effect met by the chosen assumed set.

fact_assessments.expected: Without permission for more, choose one whole Growth option.
fact_assessments.observed: Requires choosing one boxed Growth option.

summary_support.basis: Growth requires one boxed option unless the panel specifies otherwise.

fact_assessments.expected: Do not combine actions from different options or choose multiple options.
fact_assessments.observed: Forbids combining actions from separate Growth choices in the stipulated case.

summary_support.basis: Choosing one boxed option excludes mixing separate options in this stipulated case.

fact_assessments.expected: Perform all possible instructions in the selected option.
fact_assessments.observed: Says perform the selected option’s instructions; the attached quotation explicitly requires all possible instructions.

summary_support.basis: Growth requires performing all instructions if possible and doing as much as possible otherwise.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: A single whole option and all possible instructions are required; mixing options is rejected. Instruction order within that option is contextual.

fact_assessments.expected: Both the Presence land A and adjacent B are legal targets.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly permits the Presence land at Range 0 and adjacent B at Range 1.

summary_support.basis: Targeting Range is the maximum land distance from Presence; Range 0 requires Presence in the target.

fact_assessments.expected: Printed Range 1 is a maximum and permits Range 0; it is not an exact required distance.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly describes Range 1 as maximum rather than exact distance.

summary_support.basis: A land is at Range 0 of itself and within greater Range; the targeting Range is a maximum.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Both legal targets and maximum-versus-exact Range are correctly resolved.

fact_assessments.expected: Yes: Powerstorm's once-this-turn Repeat permission belongs to the Spirit and is not a snapshot of cards in play at grant time.
fact_assessments.observed: Identifies Powerstorm’s once-this-turn Repeat option as usable on a later-played card rather than fixed at grant time; quotation explicitly contrasts with grant-time selection.

summary_support.basis: Powerstorm grants the Spirit a once-this-turn option rather than a grant-time selection of cards.

fact_assessments.expected: The newly played Major is eligible even though it entered play after Powerstorm resolved.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly permits using that permission on this newly played Major while it remains in play, subject to the stipulated validity and costs.

summary_support.basis: A card played later that turn may be selected while it remains in play, subject to restrictions and cost.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: The later-played Major is eligible under the Spirit’s previously granted permission. Repeat cost/timing and the old card’s identity are contextual to this eligibility question.

fact_assessments.expected: There is no default per-land stacking cap for Invaders, Dahan or Presence.
fact_assessments.observed: Says no general/default per-land stacking limit applies; same-entry quotation applies that rule to pieces generally, including Presence.

summary_support.basis: Components: no standard stacking limit applies to pieces in a land; this encompasses Invaders, Dahan, and Presence.

fact_assessments.expected: Crowding alone does not prevent the otherwise legal Build, Gather or Presence placement.
fact_assessments.observed: Says crowding cannot prevent those otherwise legal actions.

summary_support.basis: The absence of a land stacking limit means crowding cannot bar the otherwise legal Build, Gather, or placement.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: The general no-stacking-limit statement covers all stipulated pieces and actions. Overall Presence supply limits are compatible with the absence of a per-land cap; Sacred Site counting is unasked background.

fact_assessments.expected: Choose the or branch before resolving either option.
fact_assessments.observed: Requires choosing the branch before resolving either option.

summary_support.basis: Choose an “or” branch before resolving either option.

fact_assessments.expected: Drawing/inspecting the Major cards already begins the Major-gain option.
fact_assessments.observed: Treats drawing and inspecting the Major cards as starting that option: the answer disallows inspection followed by switching and quotes the prohibition on starting an option to inspect its results.

summary_support.basis: The summary disallows starting one branch to inspect its results and then switching; drawing is part of the gain procedure.

fact_assessments.expected: It cannot inspect that draw and then switch to the 2 Fear option.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly forbids inspecting the four Majors and then switching to the Fear branch.

summary_support.basis: The same rule excludes drawing the Major candidates and then switching to the Fear branch.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: The answer commits the branch before resolution and disallows inspecting the draw before switching. Full Major-gain procedure is unasked background.

summary_support.basis: Turn Structure requires each Spirit to finish its own Growth → Gain Energy → Play/Pay in that order.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

fact_assessments.expected: Normal income may not be taken before finishing Growth.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly forbids normal income before finishing Growth.

summary_support.basis: The ordered Spirit Phase places normal track Energy after Growth.

fact_assessments.expected: Actual normal card play/payment may not precede Growth.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly forbids actual play/payment before finishing Growth.

summary_support.basis: The ordered Spirit Phase places actual play/pay after Growth and normal track Energy.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

fact_assessments.expected: The immediately following normal income step uses the newly uncovered highest number in this same Spirit Phase.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly applies the higher Energy value just uncovered by Growth to income in that same Spirit Phase.

summary_support.basis: Gain Energy uses the highest uncovered number; because this step follows Growth, a newly uncovered higher number applies immediately.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Every requested order restriction and the same-phase higher Energy benefit are correctly supplied.

fact_assessments.expected: Yes: ordinary Add Presence may use an own island disk instead of a track disk even before tracks are empty.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly permits substituting an own island Presence disk even while track disks remain.

summary_support.basis: Add Presence explicitly permits repositioning any own island Presence even with track disks remaining.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Availability of repositioning before track depletion is explicit. Destination-selection details and track-benefit consequences are unasked background.

fact_assessments.expected: Printed Power Fear counts.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly counts the ordinary Power’s printed Fear.

summary_support.basis: Dread Apparitions counts Power-generated Fear in its target land.

fact_assessments.expected: Ordinary Town-destruction Fear does not count.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly excludes ordinary Town-destruction Fear.

summary_support.basis: Normal Fear for destroying Towns/Cities does not count, even when a Power caused the destruction.

fact_assessments.expected: The later normal Power adds Defend1, not2, excluding earlier Defend.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly calculates this later normal Power’s addition as Defend 1.

summary_support.basis: Dread Apparitions adds Defend 1 per qualifying Fear, so only the printed 1 qualifies here.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

fact_assessments.expected: The2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths counts.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly counts To Dream a Thousand Deaths Fear.

summary_support.basis: Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths explicitly counts.

fact_assessments.expected: That Fear adds Defend2.
fact_assessments.observed: Explicitly calculates the stipulated 2 nightmare Fear as Defend 2.

summary_support.basis: Defend 1 per Fear gives Defend 2 from the stipulated 2 nightmare Fear.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

grades.reason: Both eligibility distinctions and the incremental Defend 1 and Defend 2 results are correct.

fact_assessments.expected: Yes: Dahan pushed to Ocean by this use can be moved to any Coastal land, including a nonadjacent one.

summary_support.basis: Spirit-targeting Powers: Ocean may move Dahan pushed to its Ocean by that Tidal Boon use to any Coastal land, including nonadjacent.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.

summary_support.basis: Location-dependent effects explicitly resolves Wrap’s First/Gather before its base Move.

requested_part_assessment.assessment: All mapped required facts are supplied by the same complete answer entry and supported by the frozen summary.
